newsitem.title: USA: Snyder Oil stake raised by Oak Tree group.
newsitem.headline: Snyder Oil stake raised by Oak Tree group.

text.p: A group including Oak Tree Partners L.P. said Friday it raised its stake in Snyder Oil Corp to 2,006,407 common shares or 6.3 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 334,500 common bought between November 7, 1996 and January 17, 1997 at prices ranging from $16 to $19.125 per share.
The group said it acquired the stake for investment purposes.
Snyder Oil, based in Fort Worth, Texas, is engaged in acquisition, production, development and exploration of domestic oil and gas properties.
